arxiv-2002-01863.title: Z production in pPb collisions and charmonium production in PbPb ultra-peripheral collisions at LHCb
arxiv-2002-01863.creator: Hengne Li, on behalf of the LHCb collaboration
arxiv-2002-01863.description: Abstract This article presents recent results of the Z boson production in the proton-lead collisions and the charmonium production in the ultra-peripheral lead-lead collisions at the LHC collected during 2013 to 2018 by the LHCb detector. The potential heavy ion programs in these topics are also discussed.

arxiv-2105-02820.title: Simulating the DFT Algorithm for Audio Processing
arxiv-2105-02820.creator: Omkar Deshpande, Kharanshu Solanki, Sree Pujitha Suribhatla, Sanya Zaveri, Luv Ghodasara
arxiv-2105-02820.description: Abstract Since the evolution of digital computers, the storage of data has always been in terms of discrete bits that can store values of either 1 or 0. Hence, all computer programs (such as MATLAB), convert any input continuous signal into a discrete dataset.

arxiv-2212-00326.title: Shift current response in elemental two-dimensional ferroelectrics
arxiv-2212-00326.creator: Zhuang Qian, Jian Zhou, Hua Wang, Shi Liu
arxiv-2212-00326.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhuang Qian, Jian Zhou, Hua Wang, Shi Liu. A bulk material without inversion symmetry can generate a direct current under illumination. This interface-free current generation mechanism, referred to as the bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE), does not rely on p p - n n junctions. Here, we explore the shift current generation, a major mechanism responsible for the BPVE, in single-element two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectrics represented by phosphorene-like monolayers of As, Sb, and Bi.

arxiv-2303-00233.description: Abstract . The recent development of multimodal single-cell technology has made the possibility of acquiring multiple omics data from individual cells, thereby enabling a deeper understanding of cellular states and dynamics. Nevertheless, the proliferation of multimodal single-cell data also introduces tremendous challenges in modeling the complex interactions among different modalities.

arxiv-2312-11192.title: The bar pattern speed of the Large Magellanic Cloud
arxiv-2312-11192.creator: Ó. Jiménez-Arranz, L. Chemin, M. Romero-Gómez, X. Luri, P. Adamczyk, A. Castro-Ginard, S. Roca-Fàbrega, P. J. McMillan, M.-R. L. Cioni
arxiv-2312-11192.description: Abstract Context. The Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) internal kinematics have been studied in unprecedented depth thanks to the excellent quality of the Gaia mission data, revealing the disc’s non-axisymmetric structure. Aims. We want to constrain the LMC bar pattern speed using the astrometric and spectroscopic data from the Gaia mission. Methods.

arxiv-2407-10688.title: Probability Passing for Graph Neural Networks: Graph Structure and Representations Joint Learning
arxiv-2407-10688.creator: Ziyan Wang, Yaxuan He, Bin Liu
arxiv-2407-10688.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ziyan Wang, Yaxuan He, Bin Liu. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved notable success in the analysis of non-Euclidean data across a wide range of domains. However, their applicability is constrained by the dependence on the observed graph structure. To solve this problem, Latent Graph Inference (LGI) is proposed to infer a task-specific latent structure by computing similarity or edge probability of node features and then apply a GNN to produce predictions.

arxiv-2408-01313.title: Optimal limits of continuously monitored thermometers and their Hamiltonian structure
arxiv-2408-01313.creator: Mohammad Mehboudi, Florian Meier, Marcus Huber, Harry J. D. Miller
arxiv-2408-01313.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Mehboudi, Florian Meier, Marcus Huber, Harry J. D. Miller. We investigate the fundamental and practical precision limits of thermometry in bosonic and fermionic environments by coupling an N N -level probe to them and continuously monitoring it. Our findings show that the ultimate precision limit, quantified by the Fisher information, scales linearly with N N , offering an exponential improvement over equilibrium thermometry, where the scaling is only log 2 ⁡ N \log^{2}N .

arxiv-2411-14340.title: Canonical foliation of bubblesheets
arxiv-2411-14340.creator: Jean Lagacé, Stephen Lynch
arxiv-2411-14340.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jean Lagacé, Stephen Lynch. We introduce a new curvature condition for high-codimension submanifolds of a Riemannian ambient space, called quasi-parallel mean curvature (QPMC). The class of submanifolds with QPMC includes all CMC hypersurfaces and submanifolds with parallel mean curvature. We use our notion of QPMC to prove that certain kinds of high-curvature regions which appear in geometric flows, called bubblesheets, can be placed in a suitable normal form.

arxiv-2502-01592.title: Graphene intercalation of the large gap quantum spin Hall insulator bismuthene
arxiv-2502-01592.creator: Lukas Gehrig, Cedric Schmitt, Jonas Erhardt, Bing Liu, Tim Wagner, Martin Kamp, Simon Moser, Ralph Claessen
arxiv-2502-01592.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lukas Gehrig, Cedric Schmitt, Jonas Erhardt, Bing Liu, Tim Wagner, Martin Kamp, Simon Moser, Ralph Claessen. The quantum spin Hall insulator bismuthene, a two-third monolayer of bismuth on SiC(0001), is distinguished by helical metallic edge states that are protected by a groundbreaking
800
meV topological gap, making it ideal for room temperature applications. This massive gap inversion arises from a unique synergy between flat honeycomb structure, strong spin orbit coupling, and an orbital filtering effect that is mediated by the substrate.

arxiv-2503-11956.title: Optimization-Based Analysis of Music Intervals and Tuning Systems in Oral Traditions Using Pitch Histograms: A Case Study of Iranian Vocal Music
arxiv-2503-11956.creator: Sepideh Shafiei, Shapour Hakam
arxiv-2503-11956.description: Abstract This paper presents a computational methodology for analyzing music intervals and tunings in microtonal oral traditions, utilizing pitch histograms, Dynamic Time Warping (DTW), and optimization techniques. By extracting pitch frequencies directly from vocal performances and aligning them with MIDI notes via DTW, we determine musical intervals using histograms.

arxiv-2509-02389.title: Rigidity in the Ginzburg–Landau approximation of harmonic spheres
arxiv-2509-02389.creator: Matilde Gianocca
arxiv-2509-02389.description: Abstract . We prove that not every harmonic map from S 2 S^{2} to S 2 S^{2} can arise as a limit of Ginzburg–Landau critical points. More precisely, we show that the only degree-one harmonic maps that can be approximated in this way are rotations.

pmc-11545737.title: Beyond Inflammation: Role of Pyroptosis Pathway Activation by Gram-Negative Bacteria and Their Outer Membrane Vesicles (OMVs) in the Interaction with the Host Cell
pmc-11545737.creator: Silvia Caterina Resta, Flora Guerra, Adelfia Talà, Cecilia Bucci, Pietro Alifano, Juan Pablo de Rivero Vaccari, W Dalton Dietrich, Robert W Keane
pmc-11545737.description: Pyroptosis is a gasdermin-mediated pro-inflammatory programmed cell death that, during microbial infections, aims to restrict the spreading of bacteria. Nevertheless, excessive pyroptosis activation leads to inflammation levels that are detrimental to the host. Pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs) present in bacteria and outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) can trigger pyroptosis pathways in different cell types with different outcomes.

pmc-11715312.creator: Connor Duncan Richardson
pmc-11715312.description: BackgroundEvidence from epidemiological and clinical studies of the effect of anti‐inflammatory medication on dementia risk has been mixed. Over the past two decades there has been recurring epidemiological evidence that the use of NSAID’s for chronic inflammatory conditions is associated with a lower incidence of dementia.

pmc-13564011.title: Diabetes, Adiposity, and Functional Phenotypes in HFpEF: A Systematic Review of Recent Treatment-Response Evidence
pmc-13564011.creator: Mulusew Goshe, Sarah Singh, Rabia Zameer, Jawad Ali, Neha Kumari, Mehta Das
pmc-13564011.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is increasingly understood as a heterogeneous syndrome in which cardiometabolic and functional phenotypes may influence treatment response beyond ejection fraction alone. This systematic review synthesized recent clinical and trial-derived evidence published from June 2025 to May 2026 evaluating cardiometabolic phenotypes and therapeutic response in adults with HFpEF or closely related heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction populations.

pmc-13577190.creator: Himanshu Saini, Jyoti Yadav, Vishal Johar, Shalu Vyas, Vikrant Jaryan, Atin Kumar, Deepak Nanda, Anand Kumar, Jeevan Jyoti Kaushik, Sahil Shamkuwar, Shubham Singh, Neetu Rawal
pmc-13577190.description: Medicinal and aromatic plants (MAPs) produce a remarkable diversity of specialized metabolites with significant pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and industrial value. Although advances in long‐read sequencing, chromosome‐scale genome assembly, and pangenomics have greatly expanded genomic resources, the mechanistic links between genome architecture and phytochemical diversity remain incompletely understood.
